title: Moving and voter registration - federal/state boundary
facts: Voter-registration procedures and deadlines are administered under state law within the federal election-law framework.
Moving to a new address does not automatically guarantee that a voter registration record is updated through USPS Change of Address.
A person who moves should check the election authority for the new residence and applicable registration or update deadline.
Eligibility and registration details should be verified using current official state election information.
